name: Hide Completed Packs
description: Dynamically hides completed Map Packs and Gauntlets with separate toggles for each.

hide-completed-gauntlets.name: Hide Completed Gauntlets
hide-completed-gauntlets.description: When enabled, Gauntlets that you have fully completed will be hidden.

hide-completed-mappacks.name: Hide Completed Map Packs
hide-completed-mappacks.description: When enabled, Map Packs that you have fully completed will be hidden.
